LightningComponentBundle.description: [Mintel UI] Related records as a board grouped by a picklist; drag or "Move to" updates the record. UI API only.

property.name: relatedListId
property.label: Related list API name
property.description: Child relationship name, e.g. Opportunities, Cases, Contacts

property.name: titleField
property.label: Card title field
property.description: Field of the child object shown as the card title, e.g. Name, or CaseNumber for Cases

property.name: subtitleField
property.label: Card second line field
property.description: Field of the child object shown under the title, e.g. Amount, or Subject for Cases

property.name: hideValues
property.label: Picklist values to hide (comma-separated)
property.description: API values of the picklist, e.g. Closed Lost
